name: 2-ethylhexyl stearate
description: 2-Ethylhexyl stearate (CAS 22047-49-0 ), also marketed as Cetiol 868 and commonly referred to as ethylhexyl stearate, is a synthetic ester derived from stearic acid. It is used as a plasticizer, lubricant, and emollient carrier across multiple industrial and personal care applications. Its low volatility and good solvating power make it a practical choice for formulators balancing performance with processability. In plastics processing, it functions as a plasticizer and secondary lubricant in PVC and other polymer systems. The compound improves flexibility and reduces internal friction during extrusion or calendering. Personal care formulators incorporate it into skin creams, sunscreens, and color cosmetics as a lightweight emollient carrier. It spreads active ingredients without a greasy residue, making it ideal for topical applications. Metalworking and industrial lubricant manufacturers use it as a base fluid or additive in cutting oils and release agents. This ester is often selected where a biodegradable profile is preferred over traditional mineral oils. It also serves as a solvent and carrier for fragrance concentrates and active ingredients in leave-on cosmetic formulations. 2-Ethylhexyl stearate is supplied as a clear, pale yellow liquid in drum and IBC quantities. Standard grades include cosmetic, personal care, and technical grades to meet various manufacturing needs. Cosmetic-grade material typically meets purity specifications relevant to finished product registration requirements.
